correctness.rationale: Explicit distances by vertex type classify all forbidden geodesic triples: touching original/edge selections fail except a single incident pair, and three subdivision vertices fail exactly for a three-edge \(P_4\) in the base complete graph. \(P_4\)-free simple graphs split into isolated vertices, stars and triangles, yielding a labeled-exponential-formula EGF plus precisely \(n(n-1)\) exceptional pairs. All maximum configurations have size n and consist solely of disjoint triangle edge-subgraphs and unused original labels. Independent BFS geodesic enumeration exhaustively checked 2,131,008 sets for n=3..6; a separate exact component recurrence checked the polynomial through n=9. Finite checks only support the proof.

value.rationale: Uniform one-subdivision is a natural incidence graph connecting clique metrics and line-graph geodesic constraints. The result completely counts every GP placement rather than a single optimum, clarifies exceptional mixed original/subdivision sets, and characterizes/enumerates all maximum placements through set partitions into triangles. Its EGF exposes a reusable star/triangle component decomposition, and is not a mere scalar bound or renaming of the line-graph optimum.
